summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting a press release about a lease expansion between Logistic Properties of the Americas (LPA) and existing tenant Scharff Logística Integrada S.A. at Parque Logístico Callao in Peru. The expansion adds 38,438 square feet at market-aligned rental rates representing double-digit growth over the prior lease, commencing June 1, 2026. LPA's management highlights value creation through embedded rental growth and strong demand in a supply-constrained submarket. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
